description: Hand-labeled factual contradictions between two sources on the same concept. Used to validate the contradiction-detection pipeline and to drive Demo 2.

cases.snippet_a: Passwords must be changed every 90 days.
cases.snippet_b: Passwords must be changed every 180 days under standard account settings, though employees are welcome to change them more frequently.
cases.resolution_reason: it-security-policy-v2 has authority_level 1 (Official approved policy); it-handbook has authority_level 3 (Official documentation, informational). Security policy takes precedence.

cases.value_a: Manager approval + access ticket required for all engineers regardless of seniority
cases.snippet_a: Access to production databases requires explicit manager approval and a completed access request ticket, regardless of seniority or role.
cases.value_b: Senior Engineers have standing access without per-instance request
cases.snippet_b: Senior Engineers and above are granted standing access to production databases as part of their role, without needing to file a per-instance request, since production debugging is a core part of the senior engineering function.
cases.resolution_reason: it-access-control-policy is authority_level 1 (Official approved policy) and explicitly states it takes precedence over department SOPs for production systems; eng-production-access-policy is authority_level 2 (SOP).
